app.name: Truth Trace
app.disclaimer: Truth Trace highlights differences between statements. It does not determine guilt. Every result must be reviewed by the investigator.

login.title: Sign in
login.headlineAccent: Every difference traced to the words.
login.blurb: The engine links what two interviews say about the same moment and shows you where they part. It never returns a verdict. That part is yours.
login.auditNote: Every access is written to the audit trail.
login.lockedOut: Locked out? Your case administrator can reset access. Failed attempts are recorded.

cases.title: Cases
cases.empty: No cases yet. Create the first one.
cases.headline: Where the accounts diverge
cases.subhead: Cases you own or are a member of.

case.subject: Subject
case.noInterviews: Add at least two interviews with the same subject to compare them.

findings.title: Results
findings.scoreHint: Internal engine score, not a calibrated confidence percentage.

evidence.title: Digital evidence
evidence.hashNote: hashed on upload · verify before use

integrity.verifiedNote: The stored file matches the digest recorded at upload. This does not mean its contents are accurate or that the file is authentic.
integrity.alteredNote: The stored file no longer matches the digest recorded at upload. Analysis against this file is refused until it is resolved.

reports.title: Investigation reports
reports.pickFindings: Choose the findings to include. The report freezes them when you submit it.
reports.awaitingOther: Awaiting another reviewer — you cannot approve your own report.

waking.title: Waking the demo server…
waking.detail: The free tier sleeps when idle; the first request takes up to a minute.

audit.title: Every action, kept
audit.blurb: Append-only. Every state-changing action on case data is recorded and can never be edited or deleted. Investigators see only the cases they are a member of.

users.title: Users and roles
users.blurb: Global roles govern what a user may do system-wide. Access to an individual case is granted separately, per case.
users.name: Name
users.readOnly: read-only — only admins can add users
users.forbidden: Your role cannot view the user list. This attempt was logged.

roleHelp.investigator: Own and work the cases they are a member of. Run comparisons and record reviews.
roleHelp.supervisor: Everything above, plus decide submitted reports and view the user list.
roleHelp.admin: All cases, plus create users and assign global roles.
